What is Mesa Gateway Airport group transportation?

It is the whole vehicle and one chauffeur, reserved before you fly and assigned to your party alone — not a seat on a shared van. Executive units are offered on this route, from 9 seats to 56, and a one-way transfer starts at $295 before 8% tax. Scottsdale Sprinters sells two shapes here and nothing between them. A transfer is one price between two addresses, the terminal and your hotel, office or home, with no hourly minimum. An hourly charter buys the vehicle and chauffeur for a block of time — 4 hours on most units, 5 on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach — and the vehicle then follows your schedule. Booking ahead is how the airport itself describes the service: its ground transportation page states that "Shuttle service must be pre-arranged." What follows is the current published table — seats, bag caps, rates, minimums and the one-way transfer price.

Where does the group meet the vehicle at the airport?

At baggage claim, on one instruction from your chauffeur (every unit, 9 to 56 seats) rather than at a curb you guess at. The airport publishes where a pre-booked vehicle collects a party, and this company already publishes what its chauffeur does while a group is still inside collecting bags. The airport's words first: "Reserve sedan service in advance and enjoy convenient pickup just steps from Baggage Claim." That is a reserved, pre-arranged vehicle, which is the only kind this page sells. Ours next, published already on the Sky Harbor page and repeated word for word so two airport pages cannot describe two different arrivals: "Give us the airline and flight number when you book. We track the flight. Stay together in baggage claim until your chauffeur sends the pickup instruction for your terminal, then move as one group. A greeter who meets you at baggage claim with a name sign and helps with your bags is an optional $200 add-on." One group, one instruction: put the flight number on the booking and name a single trip lead the chauffeur can reach.

How is a transfer from the airport priced?

By the rule, not the route: a transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and longer transfers priced from the drive with the empty return included. Inside the radius the grid price stands — $295 one way in the Executive Black Sprinter. Each added stop is $50; 8% tax is the only other addition. The second half of that rule is the half most airport pages leave out. Beyond that radius the published price stands and the drive is added to it, because the chauffeur drops the party and returns empty — the vehicle is committed both ways. The checkout measures the road distance once both addresses are entered. That is why this page puts no mileage on your own trip. This site publishes a distance to this airport for exactly 2 of its neighbourhood guides — West Chandler at 15 miles and Downtown Tempe at 25 miles — and none for Scottsdale, so no Scottsdale figure is asserted here. Book both legs on one reservation and the return is credited 20% off. On an hourly charter, stops cost nothing: the time is already bought.

Which vehicle fits a corporate, team or charter group?

Count the party, then the bags, then read one row. A party above 56 moves as more than one vehicle. Rows that publish no bag number — the Mini Bus (24 Pax) — say "Confirm in writing" rather than guess.

How do we book a shuttle to the airport for a departure?

The same way, reversed, and usually on the same reservation. A departure is priced as a transfer from your address to the terminal, with no hourly minimum, and pairing it with the arrival earns the 20% return credit on one booking. Give the desk the airline, the flight number and the addresses; the pickup is set backward from the departure you are catching and stated in writing on the confirmation. An added stop is $50; hold the vehicle hourly instead and stops cost nothing. A departure needs an honest headcount and an honest bag count, because a group leaving usually carries more than it arrived with.

Things to know

  • Does Mesa Gateway Airport require a prearranged shuttle or limousine pickup? — The airport's current transportation page says sedan, limousine, and shuttle service must be prearranged. Submit the request before travel; service remains pending until the vehicle, schedule, pickup procedure, and written terms are confirmed.
  • What details do you need for a Mesa Gateway Airport pickup? — Provide the airline, flight number, scheduled arrival, passenger count, one mobile contact, every bag or equipment item, and the exact destination.
  • Where will the vehicle wait for our group? — The airport directs pickup vehicles to wait away from the terminal until passengers have arrived and collected luggage. The final written confirmation identifies the accepted contact and meeting procedure for the trip.
  • Can one vehicle hold our group and all of our luggage? — That depends on the selected vehicle, passenger count, and every suitcase, golf bag, child seat, mobility device, cooler, or event case. Published seating capacity does not establish cargo fit.
  • Can we request both arrival and departure transportation? — Yes. Submit each flight, pickup time, passenger group, contact, luggage count, and destination. Both movements remain pending until accepted in writing.
